name: wraptool connect (deprecated)
description: DEPRECATED — use the `wraptool` feature (major :1, wiring-only) instead; it is the same wiring behavior under one `harness` choice. Wire a dev container to a host-side wraptool MCP server (credential-isolated CLI tools). Image-agnostic: adds no tools of its own, only the MCP connection config. Auto-detects the host via the container's default-route gateway.

harness.description: Which container-CLI MCP client config to write: claude (.mcp.json, SSE), agy (Antigravity, .agents/mcp_config.json, Streamable HTTP /mcp), opencode (opencode.json), gemini (.gemini/settings.json), or pi (.pi/mcp.json). Host IDEs (cursor, roo) are configured host-side with `wraptool init`.

port.description: Host wraptool port, used when the URL is auto-detected.

url.description: Explicit wraptool base URL (e.g. http://172.18.0.1:8717). Empty = auto-detect the host as the container's default-route gateway.
